Asymptomatic osteolysis as a risk factor for cardiovascular disease after total hip arthroplasty: A retrospective cohort study
Abstract
Background and purpose: A clinical problem in total hip arthroplasty (THA) is periprosthetic osteolysis/aseptic loosening. There is a possible association between periprosthetic osteolysis and higher risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD).
